final: WITH source_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS source, COUNT(*) AS survey_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), benchmarks AS (SELECT SUM(survey_count) AS total_count, AVG(survey_count) AS average_count FROM source_counts) SELECT source, survey_count, survey_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share, survey_count - average_count AS above_average FROM source_counts CROSS JOIN benchmarks WHERE survey_count > average_count ORDER BY survey_count DESC, source
